subject: Renewal onramp: staffing, stakeholder roster & QBR availability
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Liu <alex.liu@rapidpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal onramp: staffing, stakeholder roster & QBR availability

Alex —

Thanks for taking the call last week. Per our conversation, RapidPay's subscription renews in early December and there are three items we want to lock down as part of the kickoff:

- confirmed stakeholder list (who will attend QBR / procurement / technical readouts)
- proposed timeline for term change and any uplift (we discussed a potential 25% throughput increase)
- a QBR date window to review performance, uplift plan, and updated SOW

Suggested QBR windows (pick one):
- Tue Nov 9 (10:00–11:00 PT)
- Thu Nov 11 (13:00–14:00 PT)
- Tue Nov 16 (09:00–10:00 PT)

I've attached a one-page mutual action plan and a draft SOW for your review. If you can confirm who from RapidPay should be in the QBR (product, infra, procurement) and what windows look like, we'll put a calendar invite together and loop in the necessary support staff.

Next steps on our side: Ben will scope expected staffing for the uplift and David will prepare a short runbook for the migration of the additional capacity.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
Redwood Inference
Attachments: RAPIDPAY_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Draft_SOW_RapidPay_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Alex Liu <alex.liu@rapidpay.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@rapidpay.com, Priya Shah <priya.shah@rapidpay.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal onramp: staffing, stakeholder roster & QBR availability

Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear note and the attachments. Quick answers:

- Stakeholders: Priya Shah (Procurement), Marco Reyes (Platform Engineering), Emily Wong (Product). I'll forward to them and confirm.
- QBR: Nov 16 (09:00 PT) works best for the exec readout. If that fills we can do Nov 11 afternoon.
- Uplift: procurement wants the uplift framed as a tier amendment (monthly commit + buffer). Pricing question below will come from Priya.

I'll confirm final attendee list by EOD Wednesday. For now, please plan for 8–10 attendees and include a short technical segment for Marco to validate the onramp steps.

Appreciate the thoroughness —
Alex
Head of Integrations, RapidPay
alex.liu@rapidpay.com | +1 (646) 222-3344

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 07:33:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal onramp: staffing, stakeholder roster & QBR availability

Vanessa / David —

Quick internal run on staffing for the proposed 25% uplift:
- Primary PM/AE coverage: Vanessa (lead), Ben (secondary)
- Solutions / Tech lead for migration: David (will own runbook + dry run)
- On-call SRE window for the first 72 hours: 2 engineers (shifted from our Dedicated team)
- Enablement / Training session: 60 min before QBR for RapidPay engineering to review cutover steps

Estimate: 3 full days of engineering prep (David + 1 SRE), then 72-hour monitoring window post-cutover. We'll draft a staffing appendix to include in the mutual action plan.

Also: to keep procurement moving, we should offer a short pricing snapshot for a tier amendment vs. a new committed tier. Vanessa, I can pull that with legal if you want to include it in the QBR packet.

Ben
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Renewal onramp: staffing, stakeholder roster & QBR availability

Alex —

Great — Nov 16, 09:00 PT is locked. I sent a calendar invite to the names you shared (Priya, Marco, Emily) and included a 15-minute tech dry-run slot on Nov 15 at 11:00 PT to walk through the cutover playbook.

Attached to the invite is: the mutual action plan (with staffing appendix), the draft SOW, and a short appendix with our uplift pricing snapshot (tier amendment vs. new commit). Ben: please review the pricing snapshot and flag anything legal needs to review. David: I'll set up a short workspace for the dry run — can you confirm availability for Nov 15 at 11:00 PT? Monica, please add the SRE rotation names to the invite once confirmed.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the QBR.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
